entities.summary: Margo Glantz Shapiro is a Mexican writer, essayist, critic and academic. She has been a member of the Academia Mexicana de la Lengua since 1995. She is a recipient of the FIL Award. Margo Glantz was a journalists & chroniclers from Mexico City (b. 1930-01-28, Mexico City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
